programme.title: The Amber May Show - Follow the Money Grocery Prices Government Fraud Hunter Biden and Fauci Under Fire
programme.desc:
Today on The Amber May Show we follow the money across some of the biggest stories affecting American families
Grocery prices remain painfully high and Matt Walsh explains why inflation government spending wars fertilizer costs drought and shrinking cattle supplies continue to hit your weekly budget
We also examine the growing crisis inside the Democratic National Committee Hunter Biden’s claim that he cannot pay a 17 million legal bill and Rep Harriet Hageman’s warning about federal education money flowing through bureaucrats consultants and nonprofit groups
JD Vance is targeting fraud across massive federal benefit programs while Glenn Beck argues President Trump may be reshaping the global order in ways Americans will not fully understand for years
Then Anthony Fauci faces pressure from two directions Rand Paul is moving forward with a contempt resolution and Florida has issued a formal subpoena seeking documents about what Fauci knew what he privately believed and whether he pursued personal profit connected to his government role
The central question today is simple Who benefits who pays and who is finally being held accountable

programme.title: Upfront in the Prophetic with Francine FosdickUpfront in the Prophetic with Francine Fosdick - From Diagnosis to Purpose A Pharmacist s Journey of Faith Wellness and Hope
programme.desc: Tonight on Upfront in the Prophetic we welcome Dr Kareem Griffith — a pharmacist man of faith and wellness advocate whose life took an unexpected turn after being diagnosed with congestive heart failure In one of the most difficult seasons of his life a dear friend reached out because they genuinely cared about what he was going through That conversation opened the door to a journey that would not only impact his health but also his purpose and outlook on wellness Tonight Dr Griffith shares Why he said “yes” to this company Why a successful pharmacist would even consider becoming involved What the products have personally meant to him The importance of cellular communication and the new acemannan technology The Kingdom-minded mission behind the company The incredible work being done through MannaRelief feeding children in over 90 countries Why this opportunity is for everyday people — not just doctors or medical professionals And how faith played a major role in his decision to become part of this movement This is more than a conversation about products It’s a conversation about purpose compassion restoration and making a difference in people’s lives

programme.title: How The Giants Returned After The Flood
programme.desc:
In this PATREON PREMIUM episode I sit down with Bennett Tanton host of Broadcasting Seeds and author of The Second Incursion Fallen Beings Giants What Walks Among Us Still to dig into one of the strangest and most ignored threads in Scripture the Nephilim post-flood giants Babel the divine council ancient gods forbidden knowledge and the supernatural rebellion behind history
Most Christians know about Goliath Far fewer ask why giants appear after the flood if the flood wiped out the corruption of Genesis 6 That question opens the door to a much larger biblical mystery involving the Watchers territorial powers ancient mythologies cryptids hybrid beings Psalm 82 Deuteronomy 32 and the war most churches are not preparing people to fight
This is not just a conversation about ancient giants It is about the supernatural worldview of the Bible the spiritual war behind the nations and the terrifying question at the heart of Bennett’s work
Did the incursion really end
